question.text: The PMS dashboard / client portal must show:

answer.text: Current portfolio, holdings, transactions, fees, TWRR, benchmark comparison

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Comprehensive client portal: holdings, transactions, fees, performance vs benchmark — transparency standard. **The Trap:** Marketing-only portals don't meet transparency requirements. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B applied. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Best-in-class PMS portals include document vault, quarterly factsheet archive, tax reports.
